name: andrewmed
description: Plugins for Claude Code and pi.

plugins.name: mattermost
plugins.description: Connects each Claude Code session to its own bot and channel in Mattermost.

plugins.name: mail
plugins.description: Reads two mailboxes over IMAP, saves drafts and trashes messages. It does not send.

plugins.name: whatsapp
plugins.description: Searches and reads the WhatsApp chats of the user in a local copy, and sends a draft only after the user approved it.

plugins.name: telegram
plugins.description: Searches and reads the Telegram chats of the user, one chat at a time, and sends a draft only after the user approved it.
